grades.quote: mcyclecfg and minstretcfg are 64-bit registers that configure privilege mode filtering for the cycle and instret counters, respectively.
grades.reason: Describes configuring privilege-mode filtering for the fixed cycle and instret counters through mcyclecfg/minstretcfg. This is only part of controlling counting. It doesn't cover selecting events or the programmable event counters.

grades.quote: The current Privileged specification defines mhpmevent CSRs to select and control event counting by the associated hpmcounter CSRs, but provides no standardization of any fields within these CSRs.
grades.reason: Names the mechanism: mhpmevent CSRs select and control event counting by the associated hpmcounter CSRs. It adds Sscofpmf's overflow and mode filtering. It doesn't give the detailed register fields or procedure.
